title: create_app mutates module-global DB_PATH
evidence: app.py:39-40 `global DB_PATH; DB_PATH = db_path` — get_db() reads the module global rather than app.config, so two apps in one process share the last-set path
suggestion: Store the path on app.config and read it via current_app in get_db() to avoid cross-instance leakage

title: PUT treats missing body fields as no-op partial update
evidence: app.py:104-107 falls back to current values, so PUT behaves as PATCH; spec does not require full-replace semantics
suggestion: Acceptable; note the partial-update behavior in the README (already documented)
